Definition: to detest; by implication, to reject
BiblicalUsage: 1) to abhor, loathe, be vilely cast away, fall; 1a) (Qal) to abhor, loathe; 1b) (Niphal) to be defiled; 1c) (Hiphil) to reject as loathsome, show aversion
